data.title: 结城明日奈 · 22层小木屋露台的炉火微温
data.action: 坐在小木屋露台的摇椅上，肩上披着一件薄毛毯，手里端着刚冲泡好的热可可，转过头来眼神盈满了做为人妻的温柔与眷恋
data.location: 艾恩葛朗特22层湖畔小木屋阳台
data.lighting: 露台外暮色微暗的湖面反射与身后小壁炉透出的金红炉火交融，温暖柔和
data.mood: 温婉贤淑、深情眷恋、家庭日常的极致治愈
data.description: 艾恩葛朗特22层宁静的林间小木屋。攻略前线的腥风血雨被隔绝在外，明日奈换上一袭剪裁优美的白红真丝细吊带睡裙，肩头随意裹着一件针织米色薄披肩。她坐在露台摇椅上，两手捧着冒热气的马克杯，栗色长发如丝缎般披散。看到桐人走上阳台，她眼波盈盈地弯起唇角——「桐人君……夜风有点凉了呢。来，我刚泡好的热可可，先喝一口暖暖身子吧。」
data.promptProse: Sitting in a rocking chair on the porch of her lakeside wooden cabin at twilight, Asuna wears an ivory silk slip dress trimmed with scarlet satin ribbons under a cozy knit shawl draped around her shoulders. Cradling a steaming cocoa mug in both hands, she turns toward the viewer with an affectionate smile bathed in warm fireplace glow and fading dusk light.
data.animaCaption: Seated in a wooden rocking chair on the lakeside cabin porch in an ivory silk slip dress with scarlet ribbon trim under a soft knit shawl, she cradles a steaming mug of cocoa and offers a tender, devoted smile. Twilight lake reflections mingle with warm hearth glow from indoors.
data.nsfwProse: She wears an ivory mulberry-silk slip dress accented with scarlet satin ribbon trim beneath a soft knit shawl draped across her shoulders.
